cohort: The study included 153 children diagnosed with ADHD who were enrolled at the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Clinic within the Department of Psychiatry at Govt. Medical College, Srinagar.
finding: The study found that the majority of children with ADHD presented before age 11, were boys from nuclear families, and the combined type of ADHD (ADHD-C) was the most commonly observed form.
mod_finding: More than two-thirds of the patients with ADHD were born via cesarean section.
